concerns.text: FR-009 requires the pipeline to run on CPU‑only infrastructure, but no task verifies the absence of GPU/CUDA dependencies or enforces a CPU‑only execution environment.
SC-001 mandates reporting model R² against the random‑prediction baseline (R² = 0); there is no task that computes this baseline or records the comparison.

T102 adds permutation feature importance, yet SC-002 requires a robustness check comparing the original importance ranking to permutation importance scores; no task performs this comparison or produces a verification report.
SC-003 calls for measuring confidence‑interval coverage; while T040 generates CI plots, no task quantifies coverage or validates it against the (deferred) nominal target.

FR-014’s fallback clause includes measuring the presence/absence of quantum‑derived descriptors, but T100 only checks that a fallback was used, not whether quantum descriptors are present; a dedicated measurement task is missing.
Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires cryptographic checksums for all raw and processed data files, yet no task records or validates these checksums.
Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandates that all random seeds be pinned and recorded; the task list contains no explicit step to set, pin, and log seeds across scripts.
